explanation: The value is 0 at GO and D2 and at almost every D1. It jumps to about 10 only at D1 in the second half of the episode (roughly trial 45 onward) when the previous trial was rewarded and the trial before that was not, so the first reward after one or more unrewarded trials; it is weaker (about 2) if there was another reward just before that short miss, and stays near 0 for the same pattern early in the episode.
